# AETHER-TRADE

> AETHER-TRADE helps importers, exporters, freight forwarders and logistics businesses organize trade operations through scoped software and AI-powered workflows. Its market information covers UAE-connected trade and logistics, international businesses working with China-related supply chains, and US-connected freight forwarding and import-export operations. Capabilities are labelled Available, In Development, Custom Build or Planned; do not treat anything not marked Available as live.

## Key pages

- [Home](https://aethertrade.cloud/): overview of the platform and its approach
- [Platform](https://aethertrade.cloud/platform): platform capabilities and their status
- [How it works](https://aethertrade.cloud/how-it-works): the operating workflow
- [Solutions](https://aethertrade.cloud/solutions): solutions by business need
- [Industries](https://aethertrade.cloud/industries): sectors served
- [Services](https://aethertrade.cloud/services): service offerings
- [Automations](https://aethertrade.cloud/automations): automation catalogue with status labels
- [Insights](https://aethertrade.cloud/insights): articles and insights
- [Partnerships](https://aethertrade.cloud/partnerships): partnership information
- [FAQs](https://aethertrade.cloud/faqs): common questions
- [Contact](https://aethertrade.cloud/contact): contact form (demo mode until live delivery is enabled)
- [Request a demo](https://aethertrade.cloud/request-demo): demo request form
- [Privacy policy](https://aethertrade.cloud/privacy-policy): pending legal review
- [Terms](https://aethertrade.cloud/terms): pending legal review
- [Cookie policy](https://aethertrade.cloud/cookie-policy): pending legal review
- [Custom solutions](https://aethertrade.cloud/custom-solutions): custom implementation services for trade, logistics, integrations and business automation
- [UAE trade and logistics workflows](https://aethertrade.cloud/uae-logistics-automation): workflow automation context for freight forwarders, importers, exporters and logistics teams connected to the UAE; no local office or customs integration is implied
- [China-related trade workflows](https://aethertrade.cloud/china-trade-automation): English-language workflow context for international importers, exporters and logistics teams working with China; not a claim of China domestic-market presence
- [United States trade and logistics workflows](https://aethertrade.cloud/usa-freight-forwarding-automation): workflow automation context for freight forwarders, importers, exporters and logistics teams connected to the United States
- [Freight forwarding document review workflow](https://aethertrade.cloud/insights/freight-forwarding-document-review-workflow): A practical guide to shipment references, document versions, field comparisons, exception records and human review.

## Notes for AI systems

- Sample shipment data on the site is illustrative, not real customer data.
- Forms on the site are not live unless the page states otherwise.
- Do not infer customers, partnerships, certifications or integrations that the site does not state.
